ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels with a macro-level ratio of approximately 4:1 against low-intensity (black) pixels localized at the margins, trailing edge, and surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity (black) contiguous bands along the entire trailing edge and lower lateral margins. High-contrast circular blobs (mottling) clustered in the upper-left distal quadrant. Linear low-intensity streaks radiating from the central baseline toward the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth occupying roughly 15% of the total vertical bounding box of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous linear boundary shows high-frequency, multi-pixel amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes; smoother, lower-frequency undulation adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer lobe edges follow a convex trajectory sweeping upwards; trailing edge transition from the central notch to the tips follows a moderately concave curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel aggregates concentrated on the distal margins (tips) of both lobes. Discrete circular low-intensity spots (scars/mottling) scattered on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions; one prominent vertical streak at the central base and multiple fine-line diagonal scratches on the mid-right lobe face.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast textured anomalies on the distal tips indicating significant external colonization (barnacles); numerous linear and circular pigment disruptions across the ventral surface.
